capabilities: Navigate notes via heading bars at the edge with hover preview cards
Open a floating outline with heading and text search, pins, word counts and open tasks
Restructure sections by dragging, renaming, changing heading levels, duplicating or moving them to new notes
Undo any plugin action from a history window
Apply visual presets, effects and CSS add-ons from a built-in catalog
extras: The author states the code was written entirely by AI with no professional review, asks users to report every bug, and notes the plugin has not been tested on real Apple devices. The README includes a privacy section: the plugin works offline except for reading the preset catalog from a GitHub repository, and sends nothing about the user or vault.
problem: Obsidian's built-in outline is a static panel, and restructuring a note's headings means editing text directly instead of manipulating sections visually.
summary: Heading bar rail along the note's edge that acts as a live table of contents, with a floating outline, search, section editing and full undo.
